protocol: Six v2 models; all neural losses averaged across seeds, not an ensemble. Target-conditioned subsets are retrospective. Exploratory iteration after v1 test inspection. Audit does not tune/reselect checkpoints.

paired_difference.sign: GCN MAE minus GRU MAE; negative favours graph
paired_difference.limitation: Exploratory intervals conditional on these fixed fits and this 24-day test. No new training periods, no hyperparameter-search uncertainty. Day resampling assumes exchangeability; 3-day blocks are sensitivity only.

cases.name: Maximum absolute error of deployed checkpoint

v1_comparison.caution: Several changes together: budget, full validation, scheduler, temporal boundary. No causal attribution to longer training alone.
